description: Get aggregated statistics for MCP tool usage. Shows total calls, success/failure rates, and average execution times per tool.

limit.description: Maximum number of tool stats to return (default: 100)

order_by.description: Field to order results by (default: total_calls)

tool_name.description: Get stats for a specific tool (optional, returns all if not specified)

name: tork_mcp_get_stats
